gates.name: Aflatoxin B1
gates.rule: measured <= pass_fraction x L -> PASS; <= L -> TEST-FIRST (confirm by HPLC); > L -> FAIL. Not measured -> TEST-FIRST with prior P(fail).
gates.flip_condition: measured <= 0.5 x limit on a representative composite sample

domestic.notes: per one Indian institute summary; verify legal basis. Desk research found FSSAI 2015 amendment lists 15 µg/kg for nuts/oilseeds for further processing (see _staging)

export_EU.notes: total aflatoxin; verify Reg. (EU) 2023/915 (B1 vs total; sorting vs direct consumption)

prior_p_fail.notes: 1 - 0.472 (47.2% of 118 samples <= 20 ppb). Feed-grade cake and a 20 ppb threshold, not the market limit; verify

gates.notes: Aflatoxin sits in a few hot kernels: sampling error often dominates assay error.

gates.name: Rancidity / lipase
gates.rule: ffa > fail -> FAIL; test_first < ffa <= fail -> TEST-FIRST; ffa <= test_first and (stabilised or hours <= window) -> PASS; unmeasured, unstabilised and hours > window -> FAIL; else TEST-FIRST.

unstabilised_window_h.notes: raw bran under normal milling; applicability to DORB to verify

gates.name: Heavy metals
gates.rule: Not measured -> TEST-FIRST. Measured vs limit (null limit -> TEST-FIRST).

inorganic_arsenic.notes: MISSING: inorganic As limit for rice-bran ingredients (FSSAI/Codex)

cadmium.notes: MISSING: Cd limit for rice-bran ingredients (FSSAI/Codex)

gates.notes: Rice bran concentrates arsenic (~1 mg/kg inorganic As reported; candidate in _staging). Add a citation before pitching.

gates.name: Food-grade provenance
gates.rule: Feed-grade or open storage -> TEST-FIRST (micro panel) and 're-source if possible'.

gates.name: Allergen
gates.rule: Always FLAG: major allergen; must be labelled; cannot support an allergen-free claim. Claim 'allergen_free' -> FAIL for that claim.

gates.name: Regulatory
gates.rule: Always FLAG: confirm FSSAI classification / approval route for a novel or non-standardised ingredient.
